results.content: 51 Copyright © 2024, Oracle and/or its affiliates 170.315(g)(7), (9), (10) Application Access and Standardized API Certified Health IT Module(s): Millennium (Clinical) CHPL Product Numbers: 15.04.04.1221.Mill.18.06.1.221107; 15.04.04.1221.Mill.24.07.1.240920 Relied Upon Software: N/A Real World Testing Methodologies The Real World Testing (RWT) methodology for Millennium (Clinical) Application Access and Standardized API certified capabilities will consist of tracking the following live production activity for each aligned certification criterion:  HL7® FHIR® API requests and responses from registered consumer applications (g10)  Applications utilizing HL7 FHIR Bulk Data extracts (g10)  Live production HL7 FHIR API requests for patients’ data in an HL7 CDA C-CDA Continuity of Care Document (CCD) format (g9)  Cumulative access events utilizing an access token for the patient persona (g7) These items will be tracked through transaction logging in a cross-database analytics tool which provides near real time activity tracking of active production environment use for analytics purposes.

results.title: 2025 CDISC + TMF US Interchange Program
results.content: By leveraging the use of data based on CDISC modeling standards USDM, CDASH, SDTM, ADaM, ARS, underlined CT, plus data-exchange standards ODM, Define-XML and Dataset-JSON, along with the CDISC CORE initiative, the presenters will cover some potential gaps that would need to be addressed to maintain data integrity and consistency across the different standards and data-exchange process. Developed in alignment with TMF Reference Model 3.3.1, the ISF RM provides a standardized framework to organize and manage essential documents at the site level. The presentation highlights best practices for integrating Regulatory Information Management (RIM) systems and TMF for trial applications, ensuring interoperability, and leveraging automation to enhance data integrity and streamline clinical trial processes. As digital health technologies like wearables increasingly capture clinical trial data, sponsors face challenges in integrating and mapping this data to CDISC standards for regulatory submissions. Attendees will learn how a unified TMF approach enables better data quality, faster document access, and stronger team alignment—all critical elements for accelerating trials and achieving broader clinical development goals.

results.title: A Pragmatic CDO's Field Guide to Data Quality — Part 8 — ...
results.content: # **A Pragmatic CDO’s Field Guide to Data Quality — Part 8 — Healthcare Data Quality Playbook: Codes, Encounters, Consent, Outcomes**. ## Healthcare quality is measured in lives and compliance. We manage ICD/CPT/LOINC/SNOMED versioning, encounter stitching, provider/payer identity, claims CDC, and PHI masking side-effects. NHS DQMI and FHIR-based quality reporting (eCQMs, Bulk FHIR) provide measurement and exchange frameworks. * **Clinical Code Stewardship**: Maintain rigorous version control for medical code systems (ICD-10, CPT, LOINC, SNOMED CT, RxNorm, UCUM). **Data contracts** must specify code system and version, validate codes against effective dates, and enforce standard units (UCUM) [1], [2]. Automated checks catch retired or unknown codes and inconsistent units to prevent downstream analytics errors. * **ADT & FHIR Interface Contracts**: Define **Admit-Discharge-Transfer (ADT)** and **FHIR API** data contracts with required fields, timeliness SLAs, and format constraints. ## Written by Adnan Masood, PhD. Dr. Adnan Masood is an Engineer, Thought Leader, Author, AI/ML PhD, Stanford Scholar, Harvard Alum, Microsoft Regional Director, and STEM Robotics Coach.
